signature: Hanns Hainlein Nur macht / H [master’s mark: cock’s head] H
literature: Private communication from the owner, May 2006
remarks: According to the owner, the instrument has been played at a=440 for some decades, using tuning bits. The tuning is accurate and the tone is lovely. Beautifully decorated garland. Ring in slide-bow, bell-bow. Flat bell-stay. Tubular slide-stays.
